traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: A grioth can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

traits.name: No Breath
traits.text: A grioth doesn't breathe except to speak and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as an inhaled poison).

traits.name: Grioth Venom
traits.text: (emotion, fear, mental, poison); Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 frightened 1 (1 round) Stage 2 frightened 2 (1 round) Stage 3 frightened 3 (1 round)

traits.name: Shock Mind
traits.text: ⬺ (enchantment, mental, occult); The grioth scout makes a Strike with a voidglass weapon. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional 2d6 (2d6) mental damage, and the target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save (this has the incapacitation trait) or become confused for 1 round.

traits.name: Invoke Haunter of the Dark
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, enchantment, mental, visual); Frequency once per day Effect The grioth cultist waves a hand in a complex pattern to invoke dark powers, dealing 3d8 (3d8) mental damage. Each nongrioth creature within 20 feet must attempt a DC 20 Will save. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature takes half damage. Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +10 (agile, finesse); Damage 1d8+2 (1d8+2) piercing plus grioth venom
